name: WorldSheetLab
description: WorldForge v2 plan section 16 'WorldSheetLab': the M1 world-sheet lab. Version-2 recipe (world.sheet present): a 16x16-macro (8 km) sheet, meso tiles of 256 x 32 u with a derived apron; the variable is mesoSteps (erosion/relaxation steps), the control is mesoSteps 0. Poses: ridge/seam at x = 0 (a real meso tile seam), from (0, surface+60, 40) pitch -60 looking -z along the seam. Pre-erosion (M1b): the macro field is still the noise continent; the painted ridge + stream-power erosion land in M1c.
